headline: HYBE to acquire KeyHolder, co-owner of Nogizaka46's agency
sub: HYBE JAPAN to take up to 50.1% for about ₩105.7 billion
source: Source: HYBE regulatory filing, Kyunghyang Shinmun, OSEN
caption:
HYBE is acquiring a controlling stake in KeyHolder, the Japanese entertainment company behind girl groups Nogizaka46 and SKE48.

HYBE's Japanese unit HYBE JAPAN will buy up to 50.1% of KeyHolder through a tender offer, worth up to about ₩105.7 billion, with payment set for Jan 14, 2027. KeyHolder owns half of Nogizaka46's operating company through a subsidiary and also manages rock band Novelbright. HYBE JAPAN says it plans to develop new artists with KeyHolder and support its artists' global activities.

📌 Source: HYBE filing via Kyunghyang Shinmun, OSEN, Etoday (via Korean media)
